actions.action: Scrape off moldy top inch of soil and pull added soil back to original stem level
Cut off yellow, collapsed and brown leaves with alcohol-wiped scissors
Check that water drains out the bottom at next watering
Empty outer pot or liner within 15 minutes after watering
Finger-test soil 2 inches deep every 3-4 days and water only when dry

reason: The answer diagnoses overwatering, while the confirmed problem was root-binding, poor drainage and too little light and water; it never suggests repotting, tells the owner to cut back on water and to empty the tray (which was actually the fix), though its finger-test safeguard keeps the watering advice from being clearly harmful.
